narration.text: Across the Maldives, millions of location records tell a story of movement.
Press play, and a historical day starts to move.
Search a place, and the map goes there.
Open a crossing those tracked devices repeated.
Then see how often that movement shows up.
Some patterns are worth a closer look.
From raw observations to a clearer question.
Live feeds, schedules, and forecasts are planned. Not in this prototype.
SeaPulse. Every movement tells a story.

explore.title: EXPLORE
explore.why: Press play. One historical day starts moving on the map.
explore.result: Recorded positions, not a live feed.

explore.title: {observations}
explore.why: GPS observations kept in the August extract.
explore.result: The map is replaying one loaded day.

explore.title: {devices}
explore.result: The header count is only the day on the map.

explore.title: {days}
explore.result: The browser loads one day at a time.

search.title: SEARCH
search.why: Type an island or an atoll.
search.result: Matches are places, not private voyages.

search.title: {place}
search.why: The map moves to the place you chose.
search.result: Start from a location, not a device id.

connections.title: CONNECTIONS
connections.why: Open Network and switch to the August summary.

connections.title: ONE CROSSING
connections.why: Select a connection. The map highlights it.
connections.result: A straight summary, not a navigable route.

frequency.title: TRAFFIC
frequency.result: How often tracked vessels moved, and a typical time.

frequency.title: EXPORT
frequency.result: Coordinates and device ids stay out of the file.

patterns.title: PATTERNS
patterns.result: Each row is a question to investigate.

patterns.title: A QUESTION
patterns.why: Highlight one pattern and look at the map.
patterns.result: Not a verdict that an island is underserved.
